api.module.name: Window and commands (API)
app.disconnected_text: No connection to mKey. The program is closed or restarting. Start it (in a terminal: mkey) — this window will reconnect by itself.
app.title: mKey
confirm.repeat_forever: Repeat forever? The actions will run until you stop them: with the Stop button, by turning the event off or by pressing Esc + Backspace + Enter together. Remember to add a pause inside the repeat.
desktop.module.name: Desktop: layouts, notifications
devices.auto_hint: A device with buttons without a standard name (for example, «Calculator» or the buttons of an unusual joystick) gets the name UnKey, UnKey2…, and such buttons get numbers: {UnKey001}, {UnKey2.001} in macros. The names do not change after reconnecting.
devices.auto_saved: Saved. Names already given keep working.
devices.auto_tag_hint: The automatic device name: its buttons without a standard name are written in macros through it (see «More»).
devices.denied: No access to devices: {n}. Open "Diagnostics" and press "Fix".
devices.none: mKey sees no input devices. Open "Diagnostics".
devices.title: Devices
devices.virtual_hint: In macros: {pad2.South} — press button A, {pad2.LX=-1} — stick fully left. Games see such a device as a real gamepad.
devices.virtual_none: None yet. A virtual device (for example, a «fake» Xbox 360 gamepad) is described in a project and appears in the system while the project is enabled. For example, in the project text:
devices.watch_hint: Press keys and buttons on any device — mKey shows a log: when, what and where was pressed, with names for macros. Stop: "Stop" or hold Esc for 2 seconds. Presses are not saved anywhere.
devices.watch_lost: Connection to mKey lost — watching stopped
diag.fix_hint: The system will ask for your password: mKey will get access to the keyboard and mouse.
diag.fixed: Done. If something still does not work, log out and log back in.
diag.logs_hint: Latest mKey log entries. Key presses are never logged.
diag.manual: Run this command in a terminal (a password will be needed):
diag.title: Diagnostics
editor.changed_on_disk: The project file was changed elsewhere. Load the new version (your edits will be lost) or keep yours?
editor.drop_here: Drag a block here from the palette or press "+ Block". It can stay empty — for example, a word replacement needs nothing else.
editor.dsl_title: Show these blocks as macro text
editor.no_events: The project has no events yet. An event is "When …" and "Do …".
editor.palette_hint: Drag a block into "Do" or click it.
editor.trigger_future_hint: Coming in a future version of mKey
editor.unknown_block: Unknown block "{type}" (its module or plugin is off)
editor.yaml_hint: The same project as text — for those who prefer it. The format is described in docs/projects.md.
editor.yaml_unsaved: The builder has unsaved changes — save them to see them here.
engine.module.name: Event engine
gpw.done: Done: project «{name}» with gamepad {pad} is created. The project is off for now.
gpw.done_hide: While the project is on, the assigned keys do not type in other programs — remember to turn it off after playing.
gpw.done_hint: Turn the project on — a gamepad appears in the system and games see it. Turn it off — the gamepad disappears. You can adjust the layout in the project editor or its file (the bindings section).
gpw.file_header: Second gamepad — created by the mKey wizard. The layout is in the bindings section (see «Bindings» in the projects help).
gpw.hide: Hide these keys from other programs
gpw.hide_hint: While the project is on, the assigned keys press only the gamepad and do not type in other windows. The emergency stop (Esc + Backspace + Enter) always works.
gpw.intro: mKey will create a virtual gamepad: games will see it as a real one, and you control it with the keyboard (and the mouse, if you like). Below is the default layout; any key can be changed.
gpw.layout_hint: On the left — the gamepad button, on the right — the key that presses it. To change it, click "Press a key…" and press the key you want.
gpw.mouse_hint: Moving the mouse tilts the right stick; when the mouse stops, the stick returns to center. While the project is on, the mouse cursor does not move.
gpw.name: Project name
gpw.smooth_hint: The stick tilts over 0.12 s instead of instantly — like a real one. Handy in racing games.
gpw.title: Second gamepad from the keyboard
home.emergency_hint: Stop everything and pause mKey (same as Esc + Backspace + Enter)
home.paused: mKey is paused after an emergency stop
home.paused_text: All macros are stopped and hotkeys are off. Press "Resume work" when you are ready.
home.running_text: Enabled projects are active. Emergency stop at any moment: Esc + Backspace + Enter together.
home.title: Home
hotkeys.module.name: Hotkeys and bindings
input.module.name: Device input
inspector.keys: Buttons and keys ({count}) — this is how they are written in macros
inspector.labeled: Buttons without a standard name ({count}) — their names in macros (hover to see the kernel code)
inspector.labeled_hint: Click a button to give it a clear name.
inspector.module.name: Device inspector
inspector.no_name: none (the auto name is used in macros)
inspector.rename_button_hint: A clear button name: in macros it will be written {Device.Name}. Use letters, digits and «_», starting with a letter. The old name keeps working.
inspector.rename_device_hint: A clear device name for macros: its buttons will be written {Name.001}. Use letters, digits and «_», starting with a letter. The old auto name (UnKey…) keeps working.
inspector.unnamed_hint: These are kernel names: the device has no auto name. To use such buttons in macros, choose «Automatic names» → «All devices» above.
inspector.wizard_has_name: already has a name — no need to rename
inspector.wizard_hint: Press the buttons of this device one by one (and move its axes). Each pressed button appears in the list — give it a clear name or skip it: its number then stays. Names are saved with «Save names».
inspector.wizard_saved: Names saved. Old names keep working.
inspector.wizard_waiting: Waiting for presses on this device…
key.no_input: mKey cannot see input devices — open "Diagnostics".
key.timeout: Time is up: nothing was pressed.
lua.module.name: Lua scripts
output.module.name: mKey output and virtual devices
places.copy_failed: Could not copy. Click the path to select it and press Ctrl+C.
places.hint: All mKey files are plain text: you can open them in any text editor. The ~ sign is your home folder.
places.title: Where things are
platform.module.name: System and permissions
plugins.hint: Plugins add new actions, conditions and triggers to mKey — they appear in the event builder as ordinary blocks. A new plugin is off until you turn it on.
plugins.install_hint: Choose a .zip archive with a plugin or enter a folder path (it must contain plugin.yaml). How to write your own plugin — docs/plugins.md.
plugins.module.name: Plugins
plugins.no_permissions: The plugin asks for no special permissions.
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.trust: A program plugin runs with your rights: mKey checks only its requests to mKey and cannot forbid it, say, the network or files. Turn on plugins whose author you trust.
projects.delete_confirm: Delete project "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create a new one or start from a template.
projects.export: Save to a file (with device button names — to share)
projects.imported: Project loaded. It is off — check it and turn it on.
projects.name: Name
projects.new_hint: A new project starts turned off: turn it on when its events are ready.
projects.script_file: Script from file {file} in the scripts folder — open it and look.
projects.scripts_warning: Scripts: {count}. A script can do anything on the computer as you — read and delete files, run programs. The project is off for now. Turn it on only if you understand the code below and trust its author.
projects.template_hint: A project from a template starts turned off: look it through and turn it on.
projects.title: Projects
rec.cli_hint: The same from a terminal: mkey rec <name> to record, mkey play <name> to replay.
rec.convert_hint: Turn the recording into builder blocks to edit it and run it with a hotkey
rec.convert_simplify_off: Every recorded move becomes a separate block: more precise, but there may be very many blocks.
rec.convert_simplify_on: Small moves merge into a few straight segments: fewer blocks, almost the same path, clicks in the same places.
rec.convert_text: mKey will create a new disabled project with a «Replay» event: presses, pauses, clicks and mouse moves become ordinary blocks. You can then adjust it, choose a hotkey and turn it on.
rec.converted: Done: the project is created and opened in the editor (it is disabled)
rec.countdown: "{name}" in {n} s — switch to the window you need
rec.new_hint: mKey will record everything you do with the keyboard and mouse to replay it later. Stop: {hotkey} in any program or the button here. What to record — in Settings.
rec.new_hint_nohotkey: mKey will record everything you do with the keyboard and mouse to replay it later. Stop with the button here (a recording key combination can be set in Settings).
rec.pause_hint: Exactly this many milliseconds between actions instead of the recorded pauses (0 — as recorded)
rec.problem: Cannot be read: {problem}. Open the file in a text editor and fix it (the folder is shown below).
rec.recording_hint: Stop: {hotkey} in any program or the button on the right.
rec.title: Recordings
recorder.module.name: Recording and replay
session.module.name: Session info
settings.file_hint: All settings are stored in the config.yaml file (see «Where things are» below). You can edit it in a text editor: every setting there has an explanation. Changes made in the file take effect after mKey restarts.
settings.hotkeys_hint: They work in any program. Written by holding: ^{LCtrl}^{RAlt}{Space} — left Ctrl and right Alt held, Space pressed. Press "Press a key…" and then press the combination.
settings.keep_config_hint: If you install mKey again, everything comes back.
settings.rec_center_hint: put the cursor in the screen center before recording — movements replay more precisely
settings.rec_coalesce_hint: ms — merge mouse movements during replay (0 — no)
settings.rec_hint: Recording starts right away with these settings, without questions: by the key combination, from the mKey icon menu, here or with mkey rec. The recording name is mKeyRec_DDMMYYYY_HHMMSS (date and time) unless you set one.
settings.rec_merge_hint: ms — movements closer than this are merged into one: shorter file, same cursor path (0 — record every one)
settings.rec_moves_hint: record (if off — only clicks and the wheel)
settings.rec_saved: Recording settings saved — they apply from the next recording
settings.remove_all_hint: Projects, settings and the log will be deleted.
settings.title: Settings
settings.uninstall_hint: Removes the program, autostart and the access rights mKey granted itself. You can keep your projects.
settings.uninstall_password: The system may ask for your password to remove device access rights.
settings.uninstall_started: Uninstall has started. mKey will close and this window will stop working — you can close it.
settings.uninstall_what: What to do with your projects and settings?
setup.access_text: To see presses and press keys, mKey needs access to input devices.
setup.autostart_hint: To start mKey automatically when you log in, run in a terminal: mkey setup
setup.done_text: Now create your first project: for example, take the "Autoclicker" template.
setup.grant_hint: The system will ask for your password. After that you may need to log out and log back in.
setup.module.name: System check
setup.test_press: 1. Press the button below, then any key on the keyboard:
setup.test_type: 2. Press the button — mKey will type the digits 12345 into the field next to it:
setup.title: mKey setup
setup.welcome_1: mKey needs access to the keyboard, mouse and gamepads — granted once with your password.
setup.welcome_2: We'll check that mKey sees your presses.
setup.welcome_3: We'll check that mKey can type.
setup.welcome_safety: If anything goes wrong, pressing Esc + Backspace + Enter together stops everything at once.
setup.welcome_text: mKey presses keys and buttons for you: on a hotkey, on a timer or on another event. Let's check that everything is ready:
